description: This file is a shell script used for automating release version bumps by analyzing commit history, PR labels, and metadata files. It parses git information, applies version bump logic, and optionally updates metadata.yaml files in a project.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays help and usage instructions for the script

methods.name: log
methods.description: Prints informational messages to standard output

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Prints warning messages to standard error

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints error messages and exits the script

methods.name: component_from_path
methods.description: Determines which component a given file path belongs to based on the list of metadata.yaml directories

methods.name: is_doc_like_path
methods.description: Checks if a file path resembles documentation or metadata files

methods.name: get_pr_for_commit
methods.description: Retrieves the pull request number associated with a commit SHA

methods.name: get_pr_labels
methods.description: Fetches labels for a pull request

methods.name: compute_next_versions
methods.description: Calculates the next version and generation based on current version and bump type

methods.name: update_metadata
methods.description: Updates the version and generation in a metadata.yaml file
